# pcd_networking_secgroup_rule (Resource)

Manages a rule within a Neutron security group. Rules are immutable: any change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_secgroup" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-secgroup"
}

resource "pcd_networking_secgroup_rule" "example" {
  direction         = "ingress"
  ethertype         = "IPv4"
  security_group_id = pcd_networking_secgroup.example.id
  protocol          = "tcp"
  port_range_min    = 22
  port_range_max    = 22
  remote_ip_prefix  = "10.0.0.0/24"
  description       = "Allow SSH from the internal subnet"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `direction` (String) Direction: ingress or egress.
- `ethertype` (String) EtherType: IPv4 or IPv6.
- `security_group_id` (String) The security group this rule belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the rule.
- `port_range_max` (Number) Upper bound of the port range.
- `port_range_min` (Number) Lower bound of the port range.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol (tcp, udp, icmp, ...).
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `remote_group_id` (String) Remote security group ID (mutually exclusive with remote_ip_prefix).
- `remote_ip_prefix` (String) Remote CIDR (mutually exclusive with remote_group_id).
- `tenant_id` (String) The owning project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_secgroup_rule.example <id>
```
